description: Keeps the empty-receptacle memory and re-visit discouragement unchanged, but narrows the 'never-visited' exploration hint so it only lists unvisited 'go to' targets whose receptacle type (the word before the number, e.g. cabinet, drawer, countertop) appears verbatim in this episode's own initial_observation room description. This stops the hint from steering the agent toward receptacles from other rooms that appeared in admissible_commands, which caused wasted steps. Still uses only the episode's own action/observation/admissible_commands stream and makes no claims about where objects are.
header: Empty-receptacle memory; unvisited hints limited to receptacles named in this room.
